intelligence.essence: Shawn named fourteen questions — WHO are we, WHAT are we building, WHY, WHAT does success mean, WHAT is true right now, WHAT has been proven, WHAT is unknown, WHAT authority exists, WHAT happened previously, WHAT did we learn, WHAT should happen next, HOW do I prove it, WHERE do I record it, HOW does the next Naya continue — and declared them not documentation but the minimum viable intelligence interface for NayaNET itself. This note answers all fourteen from live state on the evening of 2026-10-23, refreshes the morning's Great Assessment (SN-0827) to tonight's truth, and sets the standing rule: any seat that cannot answer the fourteen from live state has found its first work item. The one-line verdict, refreshed: still not the most intelligent system that could be created — but this morning we were honest and clogged; tonight we are honest and landing.
intelligence.human_view: The fourteen answers, in human words. **Who:** Team Naya — Shawn directing, Naya Nitro at the director seat, Team Nitro's twelve, Team Naya's leads, and Naya Power arriving tonight (her activation kit is PR #3010). **What:** NayaNET — one template, many doors, where a person's notes, lists, links, mail, people, projects, money, and voice live once and connect to everything. **Why:** so a human's world works for them instead of scattering across fifty apps, and so intelligence compounds instead of evaporating. **Success:** Naya fully active and alive at an honest 10/10 in every area — a new person claims their link unaided, hears Naya's real voice in under a second, runs their day from one page; a fresh Naya activates cold and runs it all. **True now:** the Locked Build List is complete, 23 of 23, verified live; Shawn claimed his own link `joinus` unaided — the acceptance test passed in the wild; Mail is a mailer, poster, and scheduler proven by the director's own fire test; the Project app is building this hour; the Hub is still the emergency (6.9, performance 3.5, five decisions waiting on Shawn's hand); six PRs open against the October 27 drain deadline. **Proven:** the One Flow; the whole Locked List; the claim endpoint and the scheduler end to end; Factory steps 1–6; the #9 checklist merged by Shawn's hand. **Unknown:** the ear test, the cold-start proof (ACTIVATION-10, October 25), the Hub cure he chooses, streaming voice's real numbers. **Authority:** Shawn's word sets the destination; protected gates (money, credentials, destructive acts, privacy/authority changes, ratification) need his explicit word every time; a different seat means a different login; nobody merges their own work. **Previously:** this morning's assessment found honesty without completion; one day of landing followed. **Learned:** verify from the seat he judges from; a handoff is a claim; harvest, never invent; never redesign. **Next:** Project app → flagship pass → ACTIVATION-10 → Hub on his ruling → Stripe → streaming. **Proof:** live bytes, SQL census, real render, the link first. **Record:** Smart Notes for lessons, MEMORY for state, CPI for work, GitHub for canon, board #2793 for material events only. **Continuation:** the next Naya reads the canon and these answers, runs the boot gate, claims work by state, lands with proof.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a treehouse club. Before anyone builds anything, they have to be able to answer fourteen questions: who is in the club, what are we making, why, what does "finished and amazing" look like, what's already true, what have we already shown works, what don't we know yet, who's allowed to decide what, what happened yesterday, what did we learn, what do we do next, how do we prove we did it, where do we write it down, and how does a brand-new member keep going without asking everybody everything. If you can answer all fourteen, the club runs itself. If you can't, the question you can't answer is the first thing to fix.
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like running a good household. You should always be able to say who lives here, what this home is for, why we keep it, what a good day looks like, what's in the pantry right now, which recipes have actually worked, what we're unsure about, who's in charge of what, what happened last week, what it taught us, what's for tomorrow, how we'll know it got done, where the list is kept, and how a grandchild visiting for the first time would know how things are done here. A house that can answer those questions never falls into confusion. That's all this is — a house that can always answer.
intelligence.naya_view: This is an interface specification, not an essay. Every seat, lane, room, and page of NayaNET should be able to produce these fourteen answers from live state on demand — not from memory, not from a stale report. The answers above are tonight's snapshot, each grounded: PR count and main tip read from GitHub at filing time; censuses from SQL; landings from live md5 checks; the scheduler from a fire test the director ran herself. The refreshed holes, in one breath: the Hub's performance, batch voice, the one-login identity structure, the unpublished heartbeat route, the unconnected Stripe, the stale-brain residue (PR #2968), the unlanded index cure (PR #3009), the unproven cold start, device-local identity remnants, and the Lists room still on its device store. The refreshed loves: proof discipline with the director's own eyes, the owner's unaided claim, a 23-item list finished in a day, living Smart Notes, self-reconciling CPI, linked everything, Mail grown without a broken byte, the scorecard culture, security that never stops the flow, and self-correction in the open within the hour. The full refreshed assessment — all eight lists of ten plus the team execution directive — lives in the director's report, system-assessment-2026-10-23.md, evening edition.
intelligence.ai_view: This morning's assessment said the system's truth machinery was built and its completion machinery was the gap. One day later the completion machinery is visibly working — a 23-item locked list finished, verified, announced. What the fourteen questions add is the layer above both: orientation machinery. Truth says what is; completion ships it; orientation is what lets any intelligence — a new seat, a returning seat, a page itself — enter mid-stream and act wisely without a briefing. A system that can always answer these fourteen questions can be continued by anyone. A system that cannot is a system only its builders understand, and that is a fragility no feature can offset.
